title: INFOEVENTBAND.com dan program-program promosinya
author: INFOEVENTBAND.COM
notes: Primary-source IEB page. The archived text states that IEB's web movement began at the end of 2010, describes IEB as an indie music information and promotion website, explicitly documents Google Search/SEO as a discovery strategy, and details offline promotion, media-partner activity, Ajang Music Charts, IEB BLAST, Android distribution, and free/premium/cooperative promotion services. The page is directly identified by the supplied IEB URL.

title: Bany oral recollection: IEB slowdown after 2013
author: Bany
notes: Project owner's oral recollection states that in 2013 he had moved back to working in Jakarta, while his first child was born in February 2013. He recalls that IEB activity subsequently slowed and the domain eventually became inactive. Exact timing of the slowdown and domain expiration remains unverified.
